spec.assertion: Structural: if skill1 has blocks, one buff effect must be stat 'atkPct', value 21.81, durationSec 20, on a target.kind 'self' block; if it has none, the line must appear in unmodeled.skill1 (no silent drop). Plus: removing skill1 leaves every teammate byte-identical (fails under an allies-scoped mis-target — ATK% cannot shift gauge/rotation, so teammate movement can only mean leakage), and if modeled it must move rapi's own total (fails under a dead/mis-gated block). Not asserted: uptime — the boss deals no damage at scope lock, so 'attacked 20 times' has no primitive and none/always-on/ramped is a modeling choice (⚑).

Exact-value counterfactual: re-authoring every skill2 flatDamage to 528.97 must leave totals bit-identical — RED under any other shipped magnitude (rounded, halved, split across effects, or absorbed into a per-shot rider). Non-vacuity: halving it must strictly lower rapi's total.

spec.kitLine: 1 enemy w/ highest final ATK (no clause)
spec.assertion: Structural: the damage block's trigger.kind is 'interval' and target.kind is 'enemy' — RED under the nearest-wrong keys 'burstCast' / 'fullBurstEnter' / 'stageEnter', which tie a clause-free damage line to the rotation and over- or under-fire whenever rapi's own cast count diverges from the team FB count. Event side: >= 2 procs over 180 s (RED for a one-shot model), bucket 'skill'.

core !== true (the kit never says 'core strike damage'), noFb !== true (riders take Full Burst by landing timing), and every emitted proc has rangeApplied !== true — RED under a rider authored as core-eligible (over-credits every core-exposed window) or FB-exempt.
unmodeled.skill2 must mention 'taunt' — the no-silent-drops record. Offensively inert by construction (no aggro model; the boss deals no damage), so no behavioural assertion is possible.

Exact-value counterfactual (nuke 657.72 + buff 60.75/10 s applied together) must be bit-identical to shipped. Event side: exactly one burst-bucket hit per Full Burst in the sole-B3 fixture — RED if the nuke is modeled per-shot or per-FB-enter — with fbMajorApplied !== true (burst-cast damage resolves before the FB window opens; a fullBurstEnter model would take the +50% major) and rangeApplied !== true.

Structural: the carrying block is trigger.kind 'burstCast' + target.kind 'self', value 60.75, durationSec 10 (seconds, not rounds/stacks). Behavioural: applications == fullBurstStart count in the sole-B3 fixture, each self-applied (casterIdx === targetIdx, targetSlug 'rapi'); in the two-Burst-III fixture applications <= FB count — RED under a fullBurstEnter mis-key, which grants the buff on Full Bursts rapi did not cast. Non-vacuity: shortening the window to 1 s strictly lowers her total; stripping the buff lowers her total while leaving teammates byte-identical.

fixtures: PRIMARY controlComp('rapi', false) — liter (B1) + crown (B2) + rapi (B3) with the fixed B3 slot dropped, so rapi is the SOLE Burst III: every fullBurstStart is necessarily her own cast, which turns #fullBurstStart into an exact, fixture-independent count of her burst casts (and B1+B2 are mandatory because a lone B3 casts zero bursts). SECONDARY controlComp('rapi', true) — two Burst IIIs — used only for the burst-cast vs full-burst-enter over-credit check, since the two triggers are indistinguishable when rapi casts every Full Burst. 8 hoisted runs total: base, two-B3, skill1-removed, skill2 at kit value, skill2 halved, burst at kit values, burst buff 1 s, burst buff stripped. NOTE: no file-write tools were available in this session, so scripts/kit-autonomy/blind/rapi.test.ts and rapi.test-spec.json could not be written to disk — the full source and spec are returned inline here.
gaps: it.skip ⚑ skill1 trigger fidelity — 'Activates when attacked 20 time(s)' has no sim primitive: the scope-lock boss deals no damage to units, so nothing counts incoming hits and the buff's real uptime (never / always-on / ramped from ~the 20th incoming hit) is measurement-gated, not derivable from kit text. Only the buff's shape and self-scope are asserted.

it.skip ⚑ skill2 'Taunt for 5 sec' — no aggro or target-selection model, and no incoming damage at scope lock, so the line is offensively inert by construction; asserted only as an unmodeled-record entry.

NOT asserted (⚑, timing-dependent): whether a skill2 interval proc happens to land inside a Full Burst window — that depends on the datamined skill cooldown, which is not a prose value. The FB-eligibility claim is instead asserted structurally as noFb !== true.
